purpose: Teach: 風貌/可憐/阿呆/ガマン/物々交換/生まれ変わっ/とやかく/おのれ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、最近大人びた風貌になったな
lines.en: Riku, you've been looking more grown-up lately.
lines.style: Casual observation, almost teasing. Light warmth underneath. Eye contact steady. Not quite a compliment but close enough to matter.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、可憐な妹さんのこと自慢してたな、桜
lines.en: You're one to talk — always going on about your cute little sister, Sakura.
lines.style: Deflecting with humor, a half-smile in the voice. Quick comeback, slightly self-conscious. Soft undercurrent of genuine pleasure at being noticed.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、阿呆な失敗繰り返すなよ
lines.en: Riku, don't keep repeating the same stupid mistakes.
lines.style: Firm but not cold. Concern masked as bluntness. Short, direct — no room for argument. The tone of someone who's watching because they care.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ガマンしすぎて体壊すなよ、桜
lines.en: And you — stop pushing yourself so hard you break something, Sakura.
lines.style: Steady and serious. Slight lean forward in the voice. Not lecturing, but the words land with weight. Quiet insistence underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、漫画の物々交換しよう
lines.en: Hey, want to swap manga sometime?
lines.style: Casual shift in energy. Lighter, almost hopeful. The kind of offer that's also an invitation to be normal together, away from the heavy stuff.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、髪型変えて生まれ変わったな、桜
lines.en: You got a new hairstyle — looks like a whole new person, Sakura.
lines.style: Genuine observation, a little startled. Soft approval in the pacing. The quiet moment of noticing someone changed and meaning it as a compliment.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、他人をとやかく言うなよ
lines.en: Don't go criticizing other people like that.
lines.style: Quick correction, steady tone. Not aggressive — more like a gentle call-out from someone who knows the better version of you. Measured.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、おのれを信じろ、桜
lines.style: Slow, deliberate opening. Quiet conviction. Like he's saying something he's rehearsed. Ends with soft stillness — the words meant to stay with her.
